analysis_rows.symptom: Architecture changes not reflected in documentation
analysis_rows.cause: Speed Over Documentation: delivering feature by Friday takes priority over diagram updates
analysis_rows.evidence: described as rational short-term behavior with devastating long-term consequence
analysis_rows.fix: include documentation updates in PR Definition of Done

analysis_rows.cause: Many Small Changes: hundreds of small changes each too minor to warrant update
analysis_rows.evidence: renaming file, adding utility package, switching library, extracting function all individually insignificant
analysis_rows.fix: automate drift detection in CI with threshold gate

analysis_rows.symptom: Inaccurate understanding of system structure after team turnover
analysis_rows.cause: Team Turnover: engineers leaving take implicit knowledge; new team makes changes based on code not documentation
analysis_rows.evidence: widened drift from mismatch between code and documentation understanding
analysis_rows.fix: maintain architecture-as-code and run architecture reviews

analysis_rows.symptom: Drift remains invisible until incident or audit
analysis_rows.cause: Lack of Feedback Loops: nobody checks if documentation matches reality
analysis_rows.evidence: only discovery methods are incidents, audits, or new engineer observation
analysis_rows.fix: set up drift detection and alerts

analysis_rows.cause: Emergency Changes: production incidents require bypassing normal review processes
analysis_rows.evidence: direct database connection, hardcoded configuration, temporary cache become permanent
analysis_rows.fix: make documentation updates part of incident response

analysis_rows.symptom: Bad architectural decisions made by architects
analysis_rows.cause: Decision based on outdated documentation showing inaccurate service load or properties
analysis_rows.evidence: example: synchronous dependency decision based on documented low traffic, actual traffic 10x higher
analysis_rows.fix: keep documentation accurate with drift detection

analysis_rows.symptom: Slow engineer onboarding and wrong code patterns
analysis_rows.cause: Wrong architecture documentation creates wrong mental models for new engineers
analysis_rows.evidence: engineers write code not fitting actual architecture, require senior time to clarify confusion

analysis_rows.cause: Wrong architecture diagrams cause teams to trace wrong dependency chains
analysis_rows.evidence: diagrams missing critical upstream systems or showing outdated relationships
analysis_rows.fix: keep diagrams accurate with drift detection

analysis_rows.symptom: Compliance audit findings for documentation inaccuracy
analysis_rows.cause: Regulated industries require matching documentation; auditors find mismatches
analysis_rows.evidence: SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA standards include architecture documentation requirements
analysis_rows.fix: use drift detection to maintain compliance-required accuracy

analysis_rows.symptom: AI agents generate code fitting wrong architecture
analysis_rows.cause: AI agents read stale C4 model and generate code matching fictional documented architecture
analysis_rows.evidence: agent amplifies drift by generating code fitting stale documentation
analysis_rows.fix: close feedback loop with drift detection triggering documentation updates
